warrior.name: The Road to the Banner
warrior.description: Word has come that Crossroads musters arms. A warrior of any blood is expected to present themselves — and to own at least the shape of a weapon.

ranger.name: Marks on the Map
ranger.description: The scout lodges in Crossroads want ranges walked by someone who has slept under open sky. Bring what passes for a bow-hand's kit.

mage.name: Ash on the Threshold
mage.description: The Lantern Archive accepts novices who can walk the long road without losing their focus. A staff — even a poor one — marks the claim.

rogue.name: Quiet Entry
rogue.description: Crossroads has doors that do not open for loud footsteps. Someone has left a blade and a coat for a traveler willing to arrive unseen.
